answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Every agent gets three random auditors: each re-runs one claimed task and checks the marble-hard work log, so a fake cannot echo a fabricated proof to every checker. A failed audit burns a 20-token deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits and 300 audit hours, 2,000 tokens, while passing three audits through a prism of checks is under 1%. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
